description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Double Sphere Mode III (Fire, Dark)] and [Fumbling Sentiment Mode] to the user

description.name: Great Fist
description.text: One single ranged attack (0.90), grants [High Quick Cast 2]/[Critical Damage +50% 1] and [Fire, Dark Ability +30% Boost 1]/[Critical Damage +50% 2] and [Fire, Dark Ability +30% Boost 2] if the user has Jecht Gauge bar level 0/1/2, removes Jecht Gauge bar from the user

description.name: Double Sphere Mode III (Fire, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 2 with Stacking] after using a Fire/Dark ability

description.name: Fumbling Sentiment Mode
description.text: Increases Jecht Gauge Bar level by 1 after using Assault Eclipse, grants [Fumbling Sentiment Critical Chance] to the user after using Assault Eclipse or Great Fist, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
